text: Welcome to ClimateTwin AI, a smarter way to explore simulated township flooding.
Township managers sign in to one connected platform for simulated flood monitoring and decisions.
At a glance, management sees water levels, road conditions, simulated weather, township risk, and the model's current time.
The interactive digital twin connects homes, Drain One, Drain Two, the retention pond, roads, and a community shelter. Select a location to inspect its conditions.
A trained machine learning model forecasts water levels five, ten, and twenty simulated minutes ahead for all three zones. These synthetic predictions sit alongside current levels.
As the guided storm intensifies, simulated water rises. Linked roads move from open to at risk, then close when the model's road rules are crossed.
Management can compare Pump Two off and on, then operate the virtual pump when water is high enough. Its effect updates the shared model.
ClimateTwin AI brings the map, forecasts, and response controls together, helping township teams see risk and explore actions earlier.
